body.query: What segment did the customer have at 2012/8/23 21:20:00?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT c.segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-23'
  AND t.time = TIME '21:20:00';
